title: 4 Fault Lines that Could Shape the Trump-Xi Summit
gist: Trump and Xi are set to meet at the White House next week, conditional on 'conditionalities' being met; it would be their second summit of 2026 after Trump's May Beijing visit and Xi's first trip to Washington since meeting Obama in 2016, with a new set of concerns replacing the old cyberespionage agenda.
